hypotheses.claim: Kinematic pursuit/preview plus finite steering/hold response may contribute to lateral-state error; simple command saturation/sign/unit error or prefilter lag alone is unsupported.
hypotheses.supported: 665 stored cursor and float32 nominal steering calculations match exactly; no pursuit or command saturation in data. Filter and servo/hold exist. Rate-cap events occur after lateral-alone excess in both failure windows; P4 joint reaches target at first failed state.
hypotheses.unknown: Cause of the earlier lateral-state departure; ideal geometry at hull origin is not a physical tracking theorem. Different safe trajectories are not a matched intervention.
hypotheses.action: No sign flip, rear-axle repair, preview tune or filter-removal trial promoted.

hypotheses.claim: Independent longitudinal mapping competes for wheel lateral capacity and may amplify loss; a scalar feasible speed profile does not certify its execution.
hypotheses.supported: Raw long/lat demand and clipping algebra show conditional lateral-force loss; P4 common30m rear49/50clipped,41alreadylat-alone>1,8combinedonly. Safe442P rear29/52combined-only and no lat-alone>1 proves clipping is not sufficient for failure.
hypotheses.unknown: Causal effect of changing pedal allocation; removing longitudinal demand cannot immediately unclamp lateral-alone excess at fixed wheel state.
hypotheses.action: One conditional allocation-only falsification proposal; source inverse/reconstruction gate still unqualified.

inference_limits: Different closed-loop trajectories, times and controls; spatial alignment is diagnostic, not a randomized counterfactual.

Clipped with lat-only<=1 establishes algebraic combined-demand contribution at the same wheel state; it is not dynamic evidence from removing longitudinal demand. Lat-only>1 cannot become unclipped merely by removing longitudinal force at that fixed state.
Raw force demand and common vector clipping establish a mechanism in code; their association here does not isolate its causal contribution.
Lateral tracking/delay and longitudinal-lateral friction competition are at most two candidate explanations; no policy change or new experiment selected.

source_methodology.applied: Stored formula reproduction→actual action change→small fixed-root falsification→own safe finish; execution law and physical envelope are separate premises.
